title: Intrinsic vs Extrinsic Motivation Map
description: Three columns, and the middle one is the only place a reward belongs.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Motivation, Badges, and Growth Mindset Coaching

educational.audience: Club leaders designing badges and rewards

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a proposed club motivator, the learner classifies it as primarily intrinsic, primarily extrinsic, or a well-designed blend of the two.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any column to classify a motivator and see club examples
pedagogical.assessment: Classify a proposed club reward and justify it.
